searchText: Wait wait, is there no Discord option to limit who can tag here or everyone? If there is such a thing, I assume from this message that's not implemented? That seems crazy, given that every person that is remotely interested in R&D has a role here, it should have impact zero I have no idea what options there are in terms of the server restricting users but taking control of your own notifications seems like a really good idea to me. Oh I didn't get any notification that's why I'm only finding now that anyone can spam that way
